title: Factor-poset size bound for tight frames
statement:
Let $H_n$ be an $n$-dimensional Hilbert space, let $I$ be an index set with $|I|=k=mn$ for some $m\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $F=\{f_i\}_{i\in I}\subseteq H_n\setminus\{0\}$ be a tight frame with factor poset $\mathbb{F}_F$. **Factor-poset size conjecture.**

$$
|\mathbb{F}_F|\leq \sum_{\ell=0}^m \binom{m}{i}^n.
$$

Moreover, this bound is tight for the frame

$$
G=\{\underbrace{e_1,\ldots,e_1}_{m\text{ times}},\ldots,\underbrace{e_n,\ldots,e_n}_{m\text{ times}}\}.
$$

The bound is known to be exact when $n=2$, while the source reports no proof for general $n>2$.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1411.6138

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2014).
source_name: Alice Z. -Y. Chan, Martin S. Copenhaver, Sivaram K. Narayan, Logan Stokols and Allison Theobold, “On Structural Decompositions of Finite Frames”, arXiv:1411.6138 (2014).
